thread:
maria: Quick sync — we need an enumerated edge-case matrix for Gen APIs (streaming / truncation / token limits / retries) to lock the PRD and launch checklist. Can owners volunteer? Need customer examples, acceptance criteria, and which items block GA. TL;DR: want a 2-pager + prioritization matrix by EOD Wed. @aj you up?
aj: I'm on it. I'll draft matrix + risk banding. Quick Q: Do we treat resume-on-retry as 'must' or 'stretch' for Hosted GA?
maria: Hosted GA: resume-on-retry = must for low-latency chat customers (e.g., AcmeChat). For other customers, graceful truncation + clear client error = minimum. Note: Acme and HealthBank specifically requested resume.
jason: Quick list of edge cases to enumerate: 1) mid-stream truncation due to token limit; 2) partial-final token billing on aborted streams; 3) retry that duplicates tokens or causes non-idempotent side-effects; 4) function-calling across retried responses; 5) KV-cache divergence after fallback to quantized variant; 6) stream resumption semantics (catch-up vs replay); 7) rate-limit + retry/backoff interaction.
sophia: Acceptance criteria ideas: - Truncation: server includes explicit `truncation_reason` + final token index and `partial=true` flag. - Billing: bill only tokens actually sent; provide admin/dispute metadata for truncated flows. - Retry: server provides `retry_id` and `seed_state` so clients can dedupe and resume deterministically.
rick: Customer constraint: HealthBank requires truncated/incomplete generations to be marked and excluded from retention by default — that's a hard blocker for Private deployments (and likely for Hosted under their contract).
aj: I'll fold that into privacy SLOs. For the prioritization matrix I'm thinking columns: severity (user-visible), incidence (expected % of calls), operability cost, security/compliance impact, engineering effort. Each edge-case gets must/should/can.
maria: Also add acceptance tests: e2e streaming + reconnects, simulated token-limit cutoff, simulated model-fallback. Rollout plan: Canary -> 10% -> 50% -> GA with automatic fallback to last-stable-model on fail.
sophia: Ops/observability items: add histograms for partial_stream_rate, retry_duplicate_rate, truncation_reasons. Alert: partial_stream_rate > 1% over 5m. Also create customer-facing doc explaining behaviors and show code snippets for resuming streams.
aj: Volunteer owner: I'll produce the PRD draft + matrix by Tue EOD. @jason can you enumerate the acceptance-test scenarios (5) and attach curl/SDK snippets? @sophia add monitoring dashboards.
jason: Yep — will add tests and a couple minimal repro scripts. Example resumption header snippet:```
POST /v1/generate
Headers: X-Resume-Token: <token>
Body: {"prompt":"...","max_tokens":400}
```Server should return `resume_token` and `truncation_reason`.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: reminder — staging cluster has limited GPU quota next week (quota: 2x smaller). Schedule heavy end-to-end tests accordingly.
maria: Noted. @rick can you surface any compliance docs HealthBank needs? Also need to decide GA-blocking items. My proposal: 1) correct truncation marking (must), 2) safe retry idempotency primitives (must), 3) partial billing policy (should), 4) function-call retry semantics (should), 5) resume-token support (can for Dedicated/Hosted stretch).
rick: I'll provide HealthBank checklist by Mon.
aj: Locking plan: I'll mark those in the matrix and submit PRD draft for review Wed morning.
maria: Thanks — will attach this thread to the PRD epic. If anyone else has customer cases or test vectors please ping me here. :thumbsup:
